sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): striding forward, the tall staff upright in his far hand, the cape behind him, the near fist swinging, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE STAFF goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): the tall gold staff with its gold ring and, on top, the gold head holding the blue gem - as long as in image 1, upright in his far hand, swung or laid down as the pale figure holds it. Where the pale figure's gold head has LIFTED OFF the staff (floating over it, or held out in his near hand), draw the head there and the staff without it, its ring still on. His near hand is a dark armoured fist. Only him: no bolts, no rays, no gravity field, no storm, no glow; the eye's cyan stays inside the eye.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his dark boot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot low, just off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the cape, the arms and the staff follow the pale figure. The staff's foot hangs near the ground but is NOT a leg: his two legs carry him.
